svg.title: DroneID UART protection: choose either deployment
svg.desc: Option A: one radio XIAO connects directly to UART4 of a custom FC build containing the security filter. Option B: a radio XIAO connects to a second radio-disabled XIAO guard, then to a stock flight controller. Neither option requires the other. Combining both is optional. ArduPilot supports report routing; iNav still needs a report downlink implementation. Hardware and power acceptance remain open.
svg.text: Two ways to guard the UART
Choose A or B · combining both is optional
A · FC software guard · one XIAO
Radio XIAO · existing DroneID firmware
D6 TX → FC RX4
FC TX4 → D7 RX
MicoAir FC · custom firmware
UART4 filter → validated reports only
Direct DRID input · fixed budgets · command handlers excluded
No second board. The security policy runs inside the FC.
OR
B · External UART guard · two XIAOs
Radio XIAO · existing DroneID firmware
Sensor UART ↔ guard UART
Second XIAO · radios disabled
Validate → limit → regenerate DRG2 reports
Guard D4 TX → FC RX4
MicoAir FC · stock firmware + UART configuration
No FC filter patch required. Policy runs on the second XIAO.
Same reporting limits, different placement of the filter.
ArduPilot: report routing. iNav: a report downlink is still needed.
IDs, messages and RSSI remain unverified observations.
Common GND and verified power design required in either option.
Custom builds are unflashed. Hardware timing/power tests remain open.
